plain: A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says there was a matter inside the CIA so tightly held that nothing about it was put into any kind of record. He tells Michels this was a "very specific thing", "highly unusual" and "irregular" even by the agency's standards, though he does not say what the matter was.
